content.whyJoin:
The Architecture MasterPrize (AMP) is an annual international architecture award created to advance the appreciation and exposure of quality architectural design worldwide. The prize celebrates creativity and innovation in architecture, interior design, landscape architecture, architectural product design, and architectural photography, and welcomes submissions from all around the world.

For over a decade, AMP has recognized the world's most outstanding work, judged by an international jury of leading practitioners and critics. Past winners include globally renowned firms from more than 81 countries, alongside emerging voices redefining contemporary design. The 2026 winners' gala returns to the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao in partnership with the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation.

Winners receive the MasterPrize trophy, winner certification, the winner seal, and publication in the Architecture of the Year book. Winning work is also featured in the official AMP winners' showcase, giving participants international recognition through publication, media exposure, and a permanent place in the professional conversation.
content.whoShouldApply:
The Architecture MasterPrize is open to professionals and students from around the world, participating as individuals, teams, or firms. Projects may be entered across five programs: Design of the Year, Firm of the Year, Architectural Product Design, Architectural Photography, and the Student Architecture Award.

Entries can cover architecture, interior design, landscape architecture, architectural product design, or architectural photography, and the same project can be entered in multiple categories with a 30% discount on additional categories. Entry fees are calculated based on firm size, categories entered, and the deadline chosen.

This award suits architects, designers, studios, and students who want international recognition, editorial exposure, and a benchmark accolade to elevate their practice in the global design community.

faq.question: Who can enter the Architecture MasterPrize?
faq.answer: The award is open to professionals and students from around the world. Participants may enter as individuals, teams, or firms, and there is a dedicated Student Architecture Award track with reduced fees.

faq.question: What are the entry fees?
faq.answer: Professional fees are €375 per entry, and student fees are €76 per entry. Early entry starts at €264 per category, and entering the same project in multiple categories receives a 30% discount on additional categories.

faq.question: What are the key deadlines?
faq.answer: The regular deadline with a 20% discount is June 30, 2026, and the final deadline is August 31, 2026. Winners are announced four to six weeks after submissions close.

faq.question: What categories are available?
faq.answer: Projects can be entered across architecture, interior design, landscape architecture, architectural product design, and architectural photography, across programs including Design of the Year, Firm of the Year, and the Student Architecture Award.

faq.question: What do winners receive?
faq.answer: Winners receive the MasterPrize trophy, winner certification, the winner seal, and publication in the Architecture of the Year book, along with inclusion in the official winners' showcase and international media exposure.

faq.question: When is the winners' gala?
faq.answer: The 2025/26 winners' gala takes place on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, presented in partnership with the Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation.

submissionGuide.detail: Create an account on the AMP website and register your entry. Fees are calculated based on firm size, categories entered, and the deadline chosen, so the final price is confirmed in your account.

Provide high-quality images and a project description. The same project can be entered in multiple categories with a 30% discount on additional categories.
Complete payment before the final deadline of August 31, 2026 to secure jury consideration.
